title: Quasar retail evaluation binder and signoff
body:
Purpose:
This binder captures the onboarding evaluation for Quasar Retail — a mid-market e-commerce customer that will use Redwood-hosted models for product Q&A, return-advice, and customer email triage. The goal is to produce a reproducible acceptance pack: pinned prompts, private test shards, quantitative acceptance gates, regression harness, annotation notes, and a sign-off matrix for go/no-go.

Scope and constraints:
- Models under test: instruction-tuned LLM family (v-candidate-002, v-candidate-002-quantized).
- Deployment mode targeted: Redwood Hosted (initial) with Dedicated plan option after acceptance.
- Private data used in tests are stored in S3 under restricted access and were redacted by Quasar security team. No raw PII leaves their environment during annotation.
- Security review required for final signoff (see sign-off matrix).

Customer background (short):
- Quasar Retail: fast-growing omni-channel retailer focusing on consumer electronics. Use-cases: product Q&A on web, automated RMA guidance, and triage of inbound support emails for routing and draft responses.
- Volume estimate: 30–70 qps at peak once live. Initial pilot traffic: ~5000 queries/day.

Pinned prompt set (golden canonical prompts to anchor regressions):
1) Product specification Q&A (pinned-spec-01):
   "You are an expert product specialist. Based on the product record below, answer the user's question concisely and list the relevant spec keys used. If the information is not in the record, say 'I don't know - ask the manufacturer.'"
   - Example input: 'Does the XR-207 support Bluetooth 5.2 and NFC for payments?'; record: <structured product JSON>

2) Return policy / RMA advisory (pinned-rma-02):
   "User describes a damaged screen received. Describe the steps to check eligibility for an RMA and the likely next steps, using Quasar's return policy excerpt. If uncertain, explicitly recommend contacting support with order ID."

3) Email triage + reply draft (pinned-email-03):
   "Read this incoming customer email and: a) classify intent (refund/technical/other), b) extract order id, c) provide a short apology + next step message (<= 80 words) suitable for agent review."

4) Hallucination probe (pinned-hall-04):
   "Does the XR-207 include wireless charging? Answer with yes/no and cite fields from the product record. If the record lacks this field, respond 'unknown - cite: none.'"

Private dataset inventory (shards used for evaluation):
- product_faqs_quasar_v1.csv (6.2k rows) — curated FAQ pairs annotated with intent, golden answer, and canonical spec keys.
- returns_2022_2023.parquet (12k rows) — customer return descriptions with outcome labels and RMA eligibility boolean.
- inbound_emails_sample_redacted_2023.zip (3.8k emails) — redacted customer text, manually annotated for intent and order id presence.
- golden_annotations.jsonl (2.4k items) — human-approved golden responses for pinned prompts.
Notes: each file has an associated checksum and is stored in restricted S3 buckets. Access requires dataset ACL + signed NDA with Quasar.

Evaluation metrics and thresholds (acceptance criteria):
- Factuality / Hallucination: <= 5% hallucination rate on hallucination probes (pinned-hall-04).
- Intent classification (email triage): macro-F1 >= 0.92 measured on inbound_emails_sample_redacted_2023.zip.
- Gold answer match (product Q&A): exact/near-exact match >= 78% (BLEU>=0.55 and ROUGE-L>=0.62) on product_faqs_quasar_v1 after normalization.
- RMA decision accuracy: precision>=0.90 and recall>=0.88 on returns_2022_2023.parquet for eligibility label.
- Latency: p95 <= 220ms for short outputs (<=150 tokens) on hosted staging with 1x standard instance type.
- Cost: estimated token cost per 1k input+output tokens (staging profile) must be <= 90% of target budget defined in partnership doc.
- Safety violations: zero GDPR exposure issues detected in sampled outputs; any PII leakage is immediate fail.

Evaluation procedure (how to run + reproducibility):
1) Prepare environment: checkout github.com/redwood-inference/quasar-eval-runner @pr-22, install pinned docker image.
2) Mount test shards (S3 URIs in linked_artifacts) into the runner with read-only credentials.
3) Run the canonical job: `python -m eval_runner.run --spec quasar/pinset.yaml --model v-candidate-002` (CI job name: eval/quasar_acceptance/2024-11).
4) Collector outputs: per-prompt csv with model output, normalized answer, metric scores, and fail reason tags.
5) Manual review: sample 200 failed items for human audit to distinguish annotation noise vs model error.

Regression harness (CI integration):
- Regression suite lives in eval/quasar-regression. Tests: pinned prompt checks (fast), dataset-wide metrics (heavy).
- Trigger: every model candidate PR + weekly scheduled run.
- Alerts: if any acceptance gate drops more than 2 percentage points from baseline, an automated Slack alert posts to #eng-applied-ml with summary.

Annotation & labeling notes (for auditability):
- All annotations use the Quasar annotation schema version 1.4 (fields: text, intent, order_id, golden_answer, eligibility_bool, confidence).
- Normalization rules: numeric values coerced, whitespace trimmed, case-insensitive comparators. Canonical spec keys are validated against product_catalog_v2 schema.
- Edge cases: refunds vs replacements are annotated as distinct intents; ambiguous cases flagged and included in a review queue.

Sampling strategy for QA: 
- Stratified by intent and product category (electronics, accessories, home).
- Oversample low-frequency classes (warranty questions) to ensure adequate signal.
- Use time-based holdout for regression: training/population cutoff = 2023-10-01; test = samples after that date to surface data drift.

Known issues and mitigations (working log):
- Issue 1: model occasionally fabricates specific warranty durations for accessories. Mitigation: add a negative-data prompt to pinned set that requires 'unknown' if duration not present.
- Issue 2: tokenization mismatch causes slight BLEU drops for long spec lists. Mitigation: normalize tokens by joining list elements with commas before scoring.

Sign-off matrix (roles and acceptance):
- Applied ML engineer (owner): Maya Chen — confirm metrics and approve technical acceptance.
- Product owner (Quasar facing): Priya Natarajan — confirm product fit and UX acceptability.
- Customer success (deploy readiness): Jon Park — validate operational controls and escalation paths.
- Security & compliance rep: Hannah Li — finalize data-handling signoff and confirm NDA coverage.
- Exec approval: listed as optional for pilot > 50k/month projected spend.
Sign-off checklist (fields to capture in the final signoff doc):
- [ ] Metrics report attached (CSV + PDF summary)
- [ ] 200 manual audit annotations reviewed and issues logged
- [ ] Security review completed and logged (ticket JIRA-4137)
- [ ] Canary rollout plan approved (see rollout section)
- [ ] Final SLA and billing terms drafted

Rollout plan (post-acceptance):
- Phase 0 (dry-run): internal-only traffic for 48 hours, measure latency and failure modes.
- Phase 1 (canary): 5% of Quasar traffic for 7 days; monitor intent-F1, hallucination, p95 latency, agent override rate.
- Phase 2: 25% traffic with rollback window and automated fallback to v-stable-001 if hallucination spikes.
- Phase 3: full traffic and handover to platform operations for 24x7 monitoring.

Monitoring & SLOs to watch during canary:
- intent-macro-F1 (SLO target >= 0.92)
- hallucination-rate (target <= 5%)
- latency_p95 (target <= 220ms)
- agent-override-rate (target <= 8%)
- cost-per-1k-tokens (operational alert if > target*1.15)

Open questions / decisions required:
- Should we permit v-candidate-002-quantized in Dedicated pilot? (ops tradeoff: lower cost vs higher failure variability)
- Confirm retention period for audit logs for Quasar (30 vs 90 days).
- Agree on escalation owner for false positive RMAs post-launch.

Next steps (short term):
- Run full acceptance job on v-candidate-002 and push results to Confluence page linked above (owner: Maya). Target complete by 2024-11-10.
- Schedule sign-off meeting with Quasar stakeholders and S&C (Priya & Hannah).
- Create follow-up tickets for model tweaks identified in manual audit.

Appendix A: quick-run checklist for engineers (for reproducibility):
- git clone github.com/redwood-inference/quasar-eval-runner; git checkout pr-22
- export S3_TEST_BUCKET=s3://redwood-private-datasets/quasar/2023/
- docker compose up --build (use pinned image: redwood/eval-runner:2024-10-15)
- python -m eval_runner.run --spec quasar/pinset.yaml --model v-candidate-002 --out results/quasar_vc002.csv

Appendix B: sample golden pairs (normalized):
- Q: 'Does XR-207 support NFC?'; Golden: 'unknown - cite: none'
- Q: 'My screen is cracked on arrival, can I get an RMA?'; Golden: 'Check order date (<=30 days), photographic evidence required, initiate RMA via returns portal. If order >30 days, escalate to support.'

Annotations or questions, leave in-document comments or ping @Maya in #eng-applied-ml.

Document history (log):
- 2024-09-12: initial draft created by Maya Chen (baseline pins and dataset inventory)
- 2024-10-18: added regression CI config and acceptance gates (Diego)
- 2024-11-03: updated approval matrix and rollout plan (Priya)

End of binder.
